messages:
carla: Started canary rollout v2.1 -> 10% traffic at 2026-09-02T14:23Z. Quick heads-up: CTR +4% but p95 latency +40ms. More worrying — telemetry shows sample ratio ~8% control / 12% treatment instead of 90/10. Could be sampling bug or router skew. @ben @dave can you eyeball? :thinking:

ben: Can you paste the raw bucket counts and which routing policy we used (hash, sticky, range)?

carla: Counts pulled from infra metrics (raw):
```
bucket,count
control,8082
treatment,11906
```
Router: ip-hash range mapping with target mapping = treatment if hash in 0..9 (10%).

dave: That observed split for a 90/10 target is definitely off. Two possibilities: 1) telemetry labels flipped (control/treatment swapped at emit), 2) routing currently mapping a different range. Quick check: compare unique user counts per bucket to see if it's user-level sticky vs request-level.

carla: Ran unique-user check:
```
control: unique_users=7991
treatment: unique_users=11544
```
Numbers scale with request counts, so not a single-user storm.

alice: Could also be post-router quota/throttle applied asymmetrically (maybe rate-limiter only on control), or a path rewrite causing users to hit treatment path.

ben: For near-term decision: we should PAUSE any ramp to 50% until we confirm. Keep current 10% but freeze increases. Also define end-criteria for continuing the canary once fixed: minimum N per arm = 5k uniques, stability window = 30m, metric p < 0.05 and no latency regression > 20ms sustained.

dave: Agreed to freeze. I'll add a guard: if abs(observed_ratio - target_ratio) > 0.02 for >10m then revert routing to previous config. I'll also run a chi-square to confirm sample ratio mismatch.

carla: Will freeze rollout now and open a quick PR to add the guard. Notifying @oncall.

deploy-bot: Canary v2.1: freeze applied by carla at 1792001122. Autoscale/rollout halted. :white_check_mark:

ben: Quick chi-square snippet to run in eval cluster: 
```python
from scipy.stats import chisquare
observed = [8082, 11906]
# expected for 90/10 on total=19988 -> control ~17989, treatment ~1999 (labels may be reversed in telemetry)
expected = [17989, 1999]
chisquare(f_obs=observed, f_exp=expected)
```
If p << 0.01 then definitely a sampling/label issue. Also check whether telemetry tags are being applied before router logic.

carla: Good point about reversed labels — I noticed the service that tags 'variant' was recently touched in the proxy. I'll check that patch.

dave: I'll run the chi-square job and push the guard rule. If p < 0.001 AND p95 latency regression > 20ms, set auto-rollback to previous stable binary.

alice: UX ask: can we show a confidence interval and a simple 'sample ratio heatmap' on the rollout page so SREs/platform folks can spot this at a glance? I'll file a console enhancement. :+1:

carla: Opening incident INC-4532 and linking CI job + PR. Summary: freeze in place, dave running stats, ben and alice drafting guard + UX changes. Will follow up with a short postmortem once root cause confirmed. :thumbsup:
